csv_project_name: Engineering for Underground Storage Tanks Removal
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Muskogee, Oklahoma is seeking Request of Qualifications (RFQ) from qualified Engineering/Environmental Firms interested in providing professional services needed to design, specify, and oversee the removal of Underground Storage Tanks for the City's fuel station located at 301 S. Cherokee, Muskogee, OK 74403, that is no longer in use.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Underground Tank Design, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Hazardous Waste Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
title: Engineering for Underground Storage Tanks Removal
short_description: Engineering services for design and oversight of removing unused underground fuel storage tanks.
project_scope: Professional engineering and environmental services for the design, specification, and oversight of removing underground storage tanks at the City's unused fuel station. The notice does not provide tank number, size, capacity, dimensions, or other technical characteristics.
services: Engineering and environmental consulting services, including underground tank removal design, specifications, and construction oversight; disciplines requested include architecture, civil engineering, underground tank design, environmental engineering/planning/design, hazardous waste engineering, and mechanical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Project concerns underground storage tank removal rather than a bridge, building, roof, tower, or special load-bearing structure.
- Main focus is environmental/hazardous waste and remediation-related engineering.
- No indication of complex structural design, long spans, lightweight structures, or innovative structural systems.
- Falls outside sbp's core target profile and is close to excluded environmental-only or non-structural scopes.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Available information for any estimate is limited to removal of underground storage tanks at an unused municipal fuel station; no quantities, tank capacities, contamination extent, demolition scope, or replacement works are provided, so no realistic estimate is possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the notice. Because the scope is limited to tank removal-related engineering and environmental services without cost basis, service phases, or scale data, no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified engineering/environmental firms are sought to provide professional services for design, specification, and oversight of underground storage tank removal. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects is stated in the notice excerpt.
contracting_authority: City of Muskogee (Municipal Authority), Muskogee, Oklahoma, USA. Contact: A Wallace. Email: awallace@muskogeeok.gov. Phone: 918-684-6212. Fax: 918-684-6233.
notes: Target market listed as General Building. Procurement stage: RFP/RFQ. Solicitation documents available by contact. Project #: 870590-1. ProjectID: 1017669. AgencyID: 15880. DR #: 202600280726.
